Label: type
definition: Denotes the type of web resource - whether the resource routes to a download link, an informational resource or an interactive tool.
short description: See web resource type CV for enum values.

Label: title
definition: A long form title for a web resource.
short description: Long title for a web resource, typically not displayed when rendering a hyperlink.

Label: shortTitle
definition: A short title for a web resource.
short description: Short string typically used as text for link rendering a hyperlink.

Label: url
short description: Secure protocols are preferred i.e. https over http.
